title: AD HOC COMMITTEE FOR BOYLE HEIGHTS FIRE RECOVERY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the final results of water quality testing conducted on stormwater runoff…
text:
[Council File 26-0906-S7; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE FOR BOYLE HEIGHTS FIRE RECOVERY COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the final results of water quality testing conducted on stormwater runoff associated with the June 17, 2026, Boyle Heights Lineage warehouse fire and the status of the Cleanup and Abatement Order issued by the Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. INSTRUCT the Bureau of Sanitation to report back within 30 days on the feasibility of conducting additional stormwater runoff testing during the anticipated 2026–2027 El Niño storm season, including:
a. A proposed testing plan, including sampling locations, frequency, timing relative to storm events, and the pollutants or contaminants to be tested.
b. Estimated costs and stafﬁng needs, including whether the work can be absorbed by existing staff or requires overtime or contract support.
c. Whether a third-party laboratory, consultant, or academic partner is needed to conduct sampling or analysis, and the estimated cost and timeline to procure one.
2. NOTE and FILE the Bureau of Sanitation report dated September 11, 2026.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Bureau of Sanitation. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council will address water quality testing results from stormwater runoff associated with a warehouse fire in Boyle Heights and review the status of cleanup efforts.
